name: Rain, thunder, snow and their effects
note: Rain and thunder flags with their timers and the clear timer, advanced while doWeatherCycle is on; rain and thunder levels fading by 0.01 a tick in single precision; /weather with the official parser and replies; the client events as both official servers send them, on joining too; saved in checkpoints and carried through Anvil (minecraft.wiki "Weather", "Commands/weather")
deviations: durations are drawn from Circuit's own stream, not the level's random sequence: the same ranges, other values
snow and ice, filling cauldrons, extinguishing fire, wet farmland and other effects of rain are not modeled; sleeping does not end the weather
